answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 33381 Country: India Title: LADIES TARAWEEH NAMAZ WITH JAMATH IF ALLOWED OR NOT? Question: Please clarify whether tarawih salah for women is allowed or not? If it is allowed who would be the imam for that jamah? kindly clarify with full details and procedure. Answer ID: 33381 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1166/733/L=1432) Women should offer taravih salah individually like fardh salah. However, if the taravih salah is being offered at home and there are some mahram men then women can offer it behind curtain. It is makrooh tahrimi for women to perform taravih with jama’ah alone. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
